{{Top|leg}}
A '''micropanel''' was a small [[Solar collector/Legends|solar panel]] manufactured by the [[Ee]]. Micropanels located across the surface of [[Trilos]] collected [[Star/Legends|solar]] energy and stored it in [[micropowercell]]s to power their technology.
